questions.question:
Can you run the Iray probe session and the qualification capture at Painter's panels? It takes about 60 minutes in one sitting; the steps are below.

1. With no other agent using Painter, open a terminal in E:\UzmiGames\UzPainter. Take the Painter lock: `python E:\UzmiGames\Assets3D\Docs\Colaboracao\scripts\collab.py --root E:\UzmiGames\Assets3D\Docs\Colaboracao lock acquire --app Painter --owner Owner/uzpainter-iray-probe --task "iray procedure probe"` and keep the token it prints. If the lock is held, wait until it is free.
2. Start Painter 12.1.0 with `--enable-remote-scripting`, with no project open. Leave the OCIO and PAINTER_ACE_CONFIG variables unset (Legacy colour management).
3. Run `python -m tools.parity.recorder iray-probe` (about 40 min) and answer every prompt in the terminal:
   - set each panel value the prompt names and type the value the panel then shows;
   - when a prompt asks for a panel screenshot, take one with Win+Shift+S, save it as a PNG and paste its path;
   - when a prompt prints a file path, use Save Render and type that exact path, extension included.
   It saves 12 small renders (256×256, 64 samples) and finishes with a persistence check (save, close, reopen, new project).
4. Leave Painter open with no project. Run `python -m tools.parity.recorder iray parity/manifests/tier3/render-procedure/qualification-sphere.json --condition separate_session` (about 10 min: one 1200×1200 render at 256 samples, same kind of prompts).
5. Close Painter, then release the lock: `... lock release --app Painter --token <token>`.
6. Reply here with the `probe evidence:` path printed in step 3, plus the last line of step 4 (`reference staged ...`) or the `refused: ...` message.
questions.context: Painter's Python and JavaScript APIs expose none of the Iray panel settings, convergence status, denoiser, seed or Save Render (documentation scan, recorded in parity/reports/phase0/iray-capture-procedure.md). Black-box answers to the open rows of 07 §2.1 therefore need a person at the panels, and agents must not drive Painter's UI. All the code is ready and tested against the fake Painter: the probe (`iray-probe`), its analysis and the qualification job. Everything recorded stays private on your machine, outside the repository; only SHA-256 hashes enter the report.
